A busy watch guide for anyone travelling with a pet
Readers usually want a clear answer
Companion Animal Travel Desk: Preparing for Pet Travel with Aurelia Skyways

Travelling with a companion animal can be straightforward when the documents, carrier, and check-in steps are arranged in advance. Aurelia Skyways supports careful, humane handling, and the Companion Animal Travel Desk is available to help you prepare before you arrive at the skyport.

Before travel, review the health and entry papers required for your animal and keep them with you in a single folder. <<FACT F082>> Make sure the documents remain legible and are presented as requested at check-in. If your plans involve a rabbit, carry the original paperwork and any supporting records together so the review is smooth.

Carrier preparation matters just as much as paperwork. The animal should be able to stand, turn, and rest naturally, with secure fastenings and familiar bedding where permitted. For reptiles, check the travel conditions carefully before booking and confirm that the container is suitable for safe movement and stable temperature. <<FACT F078>> Gentle handling helps reduce stress, and our staff will follow calm, humane methods throughout the process.

At the skyport, arrive early enough to allow for document review and crate inspection. Keep food, water, and comfort items accessible in your hand luggage unless your route instructions say otherwise. If you are traveling with a pet such as Mia, staying organized makes the experience less stressful for everyone involved.

If you need assistance, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure for guidance that matches your route and animal type.
